scenarios.title: Assistant that picks a tool, then answers
scenarios.description: A webhook assistant chooses sheets lookup, an HTTP lookup, or a Slack note, then answers from that tool's result.

scenarios.title: Claude summarizes a sheet cell
scenarios.description: When a long note lands in column A, Claude writes a three-sentence summary in column B.

scenarios.title: Gemini summarizes a sheet cell
scenarios.description: Write a two-sentence Gemini summary of column A into column B.

scenarios.title: Knowledge-base Q&A from a sheet
scenarios.description: Pull matching FAQ rows, aggregate them, and answer a webhook question from that text only.

scenarios.title: Moderate a webhook comment
scenarios.description: Score a comment and ping Slack only when it should be blocked.

scenarios.title: Onboarding questions to an agent
scenarios.description: An agent that answers onboarding questions from a fixed three-step checklist.

scenarios.title: Policy agent over a webhook
scenarios.description: Answer a webhook with a Make AI agent that is instructed to refuse anything outside the written policy.

scenarios.title: Calendly or Cal.com booking confirmation
scenarios.description: On a booking webhook, log the invitee, email a confirmation, and text them. Cancellations take the other route.

scenarios.title: Day-before appointment reminder from the sheet
scenarios.description: Text each sheet row whose remind flag is YES. Pair it with the booking confirmation scenario.

scenarios.title: No-show webhook texts a rebook line
scenarios.description: When a booking payload says no-show, text a one-line rebook note.

scenarios.title: Pre-meeting intake brief for the host
scenarios.description: Turn an intake form into a five-line brief and post it when the brief is actually about the meeting.

scenarios.title: Reschedule webhook logged and acknowledged
scenarios.description: Log a reschedule payload and tell Slack the old and new times.

scenarios.title: Route a booking ping by host name
scenarios.description: Ping Slack with the host name, and only page when the host field is filled.

scenarios.title: Abandoned checkout text
scenarios.description: Text a shopper who left a checkout only when an email and a phone are both present.

scenarios.title: Low-stock rows to Slack
scenarios.description: Post one Slack message per sheet row whose reorder flag is YES.

scenarios.title: Negative review webhook to Slack
scenarios.description: Log a product review and ping Slack when the model calls it negative.

scenarios.title: Order line items into a sheet
scenarios.description: Split an order's line-item array into one sheet row each.

scenarios.title: Product blurb to a description cell
scenarios.description: Turn a product blurb in column A into a description in column B.

scenarios.title: Shopify order sync to Sheets, Slack, and HubSpot
scenarios.description: Log a Shopify order webhook, tell Slack, and create a HubSpot contact when the order is paid.

scenarios.title: Shopify refund webhook to Slack
scenarios.description: Log a refund payload and ping Slack when the amount is at least 100.

scenarios.title: Supplier delay email to the warehouse channel
scenarios.description: Read a supplier delay email and post the new date when one is present.

scenarios.title: VIP order amount to Slack
scenarios.description: Ping Slack when an order total scores at or above 500.

scenarios.title: WooCommerce order sync to Sheets and an order note
scenarios.description: Log a WooCommerce order webhook and write an order note back through the REST API.

scenarios.title: WooCommerce refund note back to the order
scenarios.description: Log a Woo refund webhook and write an internal order note.

scenarios.title: AI email triage and draft replies
scenarios.description: Classify a new Gmail message and leave a draft reply for sales, billing, or support instead of sending it.

scenarios.title: Classify a cold-email reply
scenarios.description: Label a reply as interested, not now, or unsubscribe, and ping Slack only for interested.

scenarios.title: Draft an acknowledgement for a new client email
scenarios.description: Log a new-client email and draft a short acknowledgement. Nothing is sent.

scenarios.title: Flag legal keywords in the shared inbox
scenarios.description: Log inbound mail and ping Slack when the model sees a contract, lawsuit, or subpoena.

scenarios.title: Intro request summarized for a double opt-in
scenarios.description: Summarize an intro request so you can ask the other person before forwarding.

scenarios.title: Log out-of-office replies and stay quiet
scenarios.description: Log auto-replies and ping Slack only when the message is not an out-of-office.

scenarios.title: Parse an order confirmation email into a sheet
scenarios.description: Turn a supplier order confirmation into order number, total, and ETA.

scenarios.title: Separate a newsletter reply from a lead
scenarios.description: Ping Slack only when a reply asks to buy, not when it says unsubscribe.

scenarios.title: Bank export rows categorized into a sheet
scenarios.description: Split a posted array of bank lines into sheet rows and one Slack summary.

scenarios.title: Failed payment webhook to email ops
scenarios.description: Log a failed payment and always tell Slack. No charge is retried from here.

scenarios.title: Invoice paid webhook to Slack
scenarios.description: Log a paid-invoice event from the billing tool and tell Slack.

scenarios.title: Monthly expense lines, described not judged
scenarios.description: Describe the expense rows marked YES. Do not call them fraud.

scenarios.title: Stripe balance transactions into a reconciliation sheet
scenarios.description: Pull recent Stripe balance transactions, write one sheet row each, and post the id list to Slack.

scenarios.title: Stripe charge succeeded webhook to a sheet
scenarios.description: Log a charge.succeeded payload and ping Slack at or above 1000.

scenarios.title: Stripe refund webhook to the sheet
scenarios.description: Log a Stripe refund and post the id.

scenarios.title: Subscription canceled webhook to Slack
scenarios.description: Log a cancellation and post the plan name.

scenarios.title: Draft a rejection from the stage in the subject
scenarios.description: Draft a short, neutral rejection. Do not send it. Do not include the score.

scenarios.title: Draft an application acknowledgement
scenarios.description: Draft a neutral acknowledgement for an application email. Do not send it.

scenarios.title: Employee referral to the hiring channel
scenarios.description: Log a referral and ping Slack when an email address is present.

scenarios.title: Interview invite drafts from a sheet
scenarios.description: Draft an interview invite for each row flagged YES. Nothing is sent.

scenarios.title: Interview notes to a scorecard cell
scenarios.description: When interview notes land in column A, write a scorecard into column B.

scenarios.title: Offer details logged for a human draft
scenarios.description: Log offer details and post them. Do not email the candidate.

scenarios.title: Parse a CV email and score it against a rubric
scenarios.description: Read an application email, score it against a written rubric, and draft a reply. Nothing is sent automatically.

scenarios.title: AI invoice extraction from Gmail to Sheets, Xero, or QuickBooks
scenarios.description: Read an invoice email, write the fields to a sheet, and draft a bill in Xero or QuickBooks when the model is confident.

scenarios.title: Invoice email flagged for approval over 5000
scenarios.description: Log an invoice email and ping Slack for approval when the total is at least 5000.

scenarios.title: Possible duplicate invoice subjects
scenarios.description: Extract the invoice number and ping Slack so a person can spot a duplicate.

scenarios.title: Receipt email to an expense sheet
scenarios.description: Pull merchant, date, and total from a receipt email and flag anything over 200.

scenarios.title: Tell a credit note from an invoice
scenarios.description: Classify a finance email as invoice or credit note and log the signed amount.

scenarios.title: Vendor statement email into a sheet
scenarios.description: Read a monthly vendor statement email and log the balance due.

scenarios.title: W-9 style email logged as received
scenarios.description: Log that a vendor emailed a tax form. Do not store the form number in Slack.

scenarios.title: AI lead capture, score, and HubSpot contact
scenarios.description: Score a new lead from a form webhook, create the HubSpot contact when they are warm, and draft email for the middle of the list.

scenarios.title: AI lead score into a Pipedrive person and deal
scenarios.description: Create a Pipedrive person from a scored lead and open a deal only when the score clears 65.

scenarios.title: AI lead score into GoHighLevel and a text
scenarios.description: Score a webhook lead, upsert the contact in GoHighLevel, and text them when the score clears 75.

scenarios.title: Airtable CRM record summary
scenarios.description: When an Airtable CRM record changes, write a short AI summary back onto the record and ping Slack if the stage is won.

scenarios.title: Booth lead with a badge email
scenarios.description: Create a HubSpot contact from a booth scan only when the badge had an email.

scenarios.title: Pricing-page question into a draft
scenarios.description: Draft a reply when a pricing-page question names a seat count.

scenarios.title: Qualify a chat widget transcript into HubSpot
scenarios.description: Read a chat transcript and create a HubSpot contact only when an email and a need are both present.

scenarios.title: Score a partner referral before a draft goes out
scenarios.description: Draft a thank-you to the partner when the referral includes a way to contact the buyer.

scenarios.title: Sheet row of a prospect to an outreach draft
scenarios.description: Draft a four-sentence outreach note into column B from the prospect in column A.

scenarios.title: Webinar registration scored into HubSpot
scenarios.description: Create a HubSpot contact for a webinar registration that names a job title.

scenarios.title: Ad spend rows with a plain-language note
scenarios.description: Read ad rows marked YES and describe only the changes the sheet already shows.

scenarios.title: Daily sales rows to a Slack note
scenarios.description: Join the rows marked Send and write a daily sales note.

scenarios.title: Hiring funnel counts to a short note
scenarios.description: Turn stage counts into a note for the hiring channel and an email.

scenarios.title: Inventory value lines emailed to ops
scenarios.description: Email a short inventory note from the rows marked YES.

scenarios.title: Month-end checklist status to Slack
scenarios.description: Summarize which close tasks are still open.

scenarios.title: Pipeline snapshot rows to a Monday note
scenarios.description: Describe the pipeline rows marked YES. No forecast.

scenarios.title: Support volume narrative
scenarios.description: Turn a week of ticket counts into a short note for Slack and email.

scenarios.title: Weekly KPI narrative to Slack and email
scenarios.description: On a schedule, join the KPI rows, ask for a short narrative, and send it to Slack and the leadership list.

scenarios.title: Apify actor run, then a sheet log
scenarios.description: Start an Apify actor from a webhook and log the run id. Dataset rows are a second step you confirm.

scenarios.title: Company domain lookup logged to a sheet
scenarios.description: Look up a domain on a placeholder enrichment URL and log the status.

scenarios.title: Fetch a company page and write a summary back to the sheet
scenarios.description: When a domain is added to a sheet, fetch the homepage, strip the HTML, and write a two-sentence summary onto the same row.

scenarios.title: Fetch a public page title into the sheet
scenarios.description: GET a URL the webhook names and log the status. The sample URL is example.com.

scenarios.title: Industry RSS items summarized to Slack
scenarios.description: Summarize a new industry feed item in two sentences and post it with the link.

scenarios.title: Job RSS items scored into a sheet
scenarios.description: Summarize a job-feed item and keep the link. Slack gets every new item.

scenarios.title: Release-notes feed for support
scenarios.description: Turn a release-notes item into two sentences a support agent can say.

scenarios.title: Bug report webhook to a ClickUp task
scenarios.description: Create a ClickUp bug from a form and log the reporter.

scenarios.title: ClickUp status webhook to Slack
scenarios.description: Log a ClickUp status change and post it.

scenarios.title: Meeting notes webhook to ClickUp tasks
scenarios.description: Create one ClickUp task from a meeting-note webhook and log it.

scenarios.title: Notion comment webhook to Slack
scenarios.description: Log a Notion comment notification and post the page title.

scenarios.title: Slack shortcut to a Notion page and a ClickUp task
scenarios.description: Turn a Slack shortcut payload into a cleaned task, then create both a Notion page and a ClickUp task.

scenarios.title: Standup sheet rows into Slack
scenarios.description: Post each standup row flagged YES, one message per person.

scenarios.title: Webhook a decision into a logged note
scenarios.description: Log a decision webhook. The HTTP step is the slot for a Notion call you connect.

scenarios.title: Competitor changelog RSS to Slack
scenarios.description: Two sentences on a competitor changelog item, plus the link.

scenarios.title: Content calendar row to a caption
scenarios.description: Write a caption into column B when a content idea is added to column A.

scenarios.title: Long note into a LinkedIn draft and a short post
scenarios.description: Turn a long note in column A into two drafts in column B.

scenarios.title: Repurpose an RSS article into LinkedIn, Facebook, and X
scenarios.description: Turn a new RSS item into three channel posts and log the copy before anything publishes.

scenarios.title: Social mention webhook to Slack
scenarios.description: Log a mention and post the text. Do not auto-reply.

scenarios.title: Testimonial cell to a one-sentence quote
scenarios.description: Compress a testimonial into one sentence that does not add praise.

scenarios.title: Weekly social stats note
scenarios.description: Describe the social stat rows marked YES. No growth advice.

scenarios.title: YouTube RSS item to show notes
scenarios.description: Turn a new video title and description into three show-note bullets.

scenarios.title: After-hours form pages only the owner
scenarios.description: Text the owner when the form says after_hours, and only log it during the day.

scenarios.title: Callback request with a named time
scenarios.description: Ping Slack when a callback form names a time. Log the ones that do not.

scenarios.title: Demo request becomes a follow-up draft
scenarios.description: Draft a demo follow-up when the request names a tool and a date. Leave a quiet note otherwise.

scenarios.title: Missed-call text-back
scenarios.description: When a call payload is marked missed, text the caller and log the number so the team can ring back.

scenarios.title: Quote request texts the owner
scenarios.description: Score a quote request and text the owner when the budget is named.

scenarios.title: Speed-to-lead SMS and email
scenarios.description: Text and email a new lead in the same run, and text the on-call owner when the form says it is after hours.

scenarios.title: Trial signup SMS and a quiet log
scenarios.description: Text a new trial user when the model thinks the company is real.

scenarios.title: CSAT webhook logged to a sheet
scenarios.description: Log a CSAT score and ping Slack when it is 2 or lower.

scenarios.title: Product changelog RSS to Slack
scenarios.description: Tell support, in two sentences, what a changelog entry actually changed.

scenarios.title: Refund language in a ticket pings finance
scenarios.description: Read a support webhook and ping finance only when the customer asked for money back.

scenarios.title: Split a ticket into bug or billing
scenarios.description: Label a ticket as bug or billing and post it to the matching Slack sentence.

scenarios.title: Status page change to Slack
scenarios.description: Log a status-page webhook and post the incident title.

scenarios.title: Support note to a macro draft
scenarios.description: Turn a pasted ticket note into a reusable macro in the next column.

scenarios.title: Support ticket classification and routing
scenarios.description: Classify a ticket webhook as urgent or normal, update Zendesk, and page Slack only for urgent ones.

scenarios.title: Ticket from a VIP domain pings Slack
scenarios.description: Ping Slack when the ticket email domain is on the VIP list in the prompt.
